demos.name: Spray wall (own footage, handheld camera)
demos.blurb: 25 s boulder on a dense spray wall filmed by hand. Camera motion is compensated with feature-matched homographies so holds and hands live in one wall coordinate frame.

demos.name: Kilter-style LED board (static camera)
demos.blurb: Lit holds define the route objectively (public CruxCam footage). The clip covers the first move; the optimizer plans the full route to the top hold for the measured climber and for a simulated shorter one.
